metadata.question: Was there an active fire present near Paradise, California between November 7, 2018 to November 10, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Paradise, California (approximately 39.76°N, 121.62°W) - Date range: November 7-10, 2018 - Collection: MODIS Terra/Aqua data for fire detection (MOD14 or similar), or Sentinel-2 for burnt area/thermal analysis - Note: November 2018 includes the Camp Fire, one of California's deadliest wildfires - Use MODIS Active Fire Product (MOD14) which detects thermal anomalies indicative of fires 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for fire detection; we're looking for thermal anomalies - MODIS fire product provides confidence scores; filter for high confidence detections (>50%) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - Valid Zero (Answer B): No fire detections found in the date/location despite valid data - Answer A: Fire detections present with confidence >50% - C1: No imagery available for the date range - C2: Valid imagery but no valid fire pixels detected - C3: Data retrieval failed or invalid result ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Paradise, California location const paradiseCoords = [-121.62, 39.76]; const geometry = ee.Geometry.Point(paradiseCoords); const roi = geometry.buffer(15000); // 15 km buffer around Paradise // Define date range: November 7-10, 2018 const startDate = '2018-11-07'; const endDate = '2018-11-10'; // Load MODIS Active Fire Product (MOD14) const fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(roi); // Check if collection has data const collectionSize = await fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Fire Images Found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No MODIS data found. Attempting Sentinel-2 thermal/burn area analysis...'); const sentinel2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(roi); const s2Size = await sentinel2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 Images Found: ${s2Size}`); if (s2Size === 0) { console.log('No satellite data available for date/location.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // Extract fire detections from MODIS const fireDetections = fireCollection.map(function(img) { return img.select('FireMask'); }); // Count fire pixels (FireMask: 0=no fire, 1-4=fire with varying confidence) const firePixelCount = fireDetections.map(function(img) { const fireMask = img.gte(1); // Fire if FireMask >= 1 return img.addBands(fireMask.rename('fire_present')); }).select('fire_present'); const stats = await firePixelCount.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const firePixels = stats['fire_present'] || 0; console.log(`Fire Pixels Detected: ${firePixels}`); // Get confidence statistics if available const confidenceStats = await fireCollection.first().select('MaxFRP').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const maxFireRadiativePower = confidenceStats['MaxFRP'] || 0; console.log(`Max Fire Radiative Power (MW): ${maxFireRadiativePower.toFixed(2)}`); // Validation and final answer if (collectionSize > 0 && firePixels > 0) { console.log('Active fire detected in Paradise, CA area during Nov 7-10, 2018'); console.log('A'); } else if (collectionSize > 0 && firePixels === 0) { console.log('No fire pixels detected despite valid satellite coverage.'); console.log('B'); } else { console.log('Unable to determine - data retrieval issues.'); console.log('C3'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
